summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Quantro landing page email form functionality after fixes. Backend email validation now works correctly with email-validator library. Frontend-backend integration is working properly for valid emails. All critical functionality is operational.

integration_issues.issue: When invalid emails bypass HTML5 validation, backend error messages are not displayed to users
integration_issues.details: HTML5 validation prevents most invalid emails from reaching backend, so this edge case rarely occurs in normal usage

passed_tests: Backend API /api/early-access accepts valid emails (200 response)
Backend API rejects invalid email formats (400 response with 'Invalid email format')
Backend API rejects missing emails (422 response)
Backend API stores valid emails in database correctly
Frontend form calls backend API successfully for valid emails
Frontend displays success message after valid email submission
Frontend form navigation works (Get Early Access button scrolls to form)
HTML5 email validation prevents invalid email submission
HTML5 validation shows proper error messages for empty/invalid emails
Form loading state works during submission
Success message content is correct ('You're on the list!')
All backend endpoints (7/7) pass API tests
Email storage and retrieval from database working correctly
success_percentage: Backend: 100% (7/7 tests passed), Frontend: 95% (12/13 features working)
